top_concerns: 12.4% headline gain is over a self-constructed, high-variance Q-HeteroFL baseline; vs Standalone/Vanilla QFL gains are ~0-2 pts, within std, and Quorus is sometimes worse
Quorus is evaluated as an ensemble of per-layer classifiers while baselines use a single output; no ensemble-matched or KD/no-KD ablation to isolate the federated layerwise loss
Noise-awareness never tested in training (noiseless simulation only); hardware eval is Funnel-only, one task, 100 test points, and shows accuracy falling with depth
Gradient-norm / barren-plateau claim is trivially explained by local per-layer losses, single task, no seeds, depths <=6; shot-efficiency never measured
Narrow scope: binary tasks, PCA-10, IID 5 clients with 128 samples each, no non-IID or privacy analysis; method mostly adapts DepthFL
